profile.name: DMG-CPU-B
profile.applicability: Original software continuation fixture for the deterministic bootless DMG-CPU-B profile; not physical hardware evidence.

protocol.store_branch: When cells 0xA000-0xA002 do not read 0xF3 0xFA 0xF1, the guest enables RAM (0x0A to 0x0000, address bit 8 clear), writes (i * 7 + 3) & 0x0F to 0xA000 + i for i = 0..511, and publishes WRAM C000=0x01.
protocol.resume_branch: When cells 0-2 hold the pattern, the guest compares every one of the 512 cells with 0xF0 | ((i * 7 + 3) & 0x0F) (the upper nibble reads as 0xF), sets WRAM C001=0xA5 only if all 512 match, then publishes C000=0x02.
protocol.missing_save: fresh RAM fails the pattern check, so the store branch runs and C000=0x01
protocol.evidence: Distinct fresh instances or processes observe the stored nibbles; this is software continuation evidence only.

scope_limits: No MBC2A or other mapper behavior claim
No BGB footer or other emulator save-format claim
The guest protocol tests file-backed continuation separately from mapper/API correctness
